title: Dimension drops by one modulo an element outside the minimal primes
statement: Let $(S,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $x\in\mathfrak m$ be an element that lies in no minimal prime ideal of $S$ (a minimal prime ideal is a prime ideal of $S$ containing no strictly smaller prime ideal). Then the Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] satisfy $\dim(S/xS)+1=\dim S$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0B52 (lemma-one-equation-module, line 15297), the equality case ('If f is not in any of the minimal primes of the support of M ... then equality holds for the right inequality'), for the module M = S, whose support is Spec S, so that dim Supp(M) = dim S and dim Supp(M/xM) = dim S/xS
